LanguageData.Gun_Saiga-12K_RWP.description: The Saiga-12K is a rapid-fire, semi-automatic combat shotgun, designed for tactical scenarios. It offers devastating close-range firepower, unleashing a barrage of shells in quick succession. Ideal for clearing rooms or repelling charges, though its effectiveness wanes with distance. Built on a rugged platform, it's reliable under harsh conditions, but its spread requires careful positioning for maximum impact.
